claims: Los Premios Soberano 2026 is the 41st edition organized by Acroarte.
Los Premios Soberano 2026 were held on Wednesday, March 18, 2026.
Los Premios Soberano 2026 were held in the Sala Carlos Piantini of the Teatro Nacional.
Jochy Santos was awarded El Gran Soberano 2026.
The conductores of Los Premios Soberano 2026 were Georgina Duluc and Irving Alberti.
Héctor Acosta "El Torito" won two estatuillas.
Los Hermanos Rosario won Mejor Álbum for Infinito Positivo.
Los Premios Soberano 2026 were broadcast on Color Visión (Canal 9) in RD.
Los Premios Soberano 2026 were broadcast on Univisión/Vix for EE.UU.
Musical performances at Los Premios Soberano 2026 included Toño Rosario.
Musical performances at Los Premios Soberano 2026 included Milly Quezada.
Musical performances at Los Premios Soberano 2026 included Elvis Crespo.
Musical performances at Los Premios Soberano 2026 included Fonseca.
